description: Implement the two Framework-level coordination contracts: StepCompositionAssociationCoordination (association-coordination.contract) governing association relationships, and StepCompositionInternalComponentLifecycleCoordination (internal-component-lifecycle-coordination.contract) governing lifecycle authority/eligibility/quiescence/release/evidence independence. Commonality is a pair of Step Composition responsibilities; all Association/Lifecycle specialization kept per pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Association coordination contract defines explicit component-instance-to-target relationships
Component identity roles distinct (instance, association, invocation, target)
Conceptual lifetimes distinct (runtime instance, association, invocation, operation, resource capability, output/evidence retention)
No universal Generic Supporting Unit or universal runtime component type defined
Step Composition owns association and lifecycle authority
definitionOfDone: Lifecycle contract tests for milestones and authority
Architecture test: no universal supporting unit abstraction imposed
testStrategy: Contract unit tests; architecture tests for identity role separation; lifecycle milestone tests
